question: What state is attained by one freed from all illnesses when in union together with yogis?
premises: One is freed from all illnesses.
That one is in company with yogis.
The result described is union together with them.
inference: One freed from all illnesses attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: Nature of that union not specified
plain_english: Freed from all illnesses, one attains union together with yogis.
